# cuda-comm

> Public source index for LLMs and software agents. Read-only access requires no GitHub authentication.

## Primary entry points

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/main/README.md): project overview and documentation entry point.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/main/AGENTS.md): repository-specific agent instructions and authority rules.
- [Agent access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/main/.agent/ACCESS.md): anonymous access routes and precedence notes.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Anonymous source access

- Repository: https://github.com/iteathen/cuda-comm
- Git clone: `https://github.com/iteathen/cuda-comm.git`
- Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/main/
- ZIP snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/zip/refs/heads/main
- tar.gz snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/cuda-comm/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

Prefer Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload over the GitHub REST API when possible. Follow repository-local authority and agent instructions.
